name: The Nature Place Day Camp
description_short: Non competitive nature day camp on 200 acres in Chestnut Ridge for ages 4 to 16, running since 1985. Campers hike, swim daily at a sandy pond, climb, canoe, garden, care for chickens and do woodworking and outdoor art, with optional overnights; enrollment is 4, 5 or 6 weeks.
notes: 2027 tuition for campers who come by car: 6 weeks $7,460, 5 weeks $6,650, 4 weeks $5,845. With bus transportation included: New Jersey $9,100 / $8,125 / $7,075; Westchester $9,450 / $8,375 / $7,275; NYC $9,875 / $8,925 / $7,925. Rates guaranteed until December 21, 2026. Four week enrollment is limited and must start week 1 or 2. Tuition includes programs, trips, overnights and swim towels. 5% sibling discount. $750 deposit goes toward tuition. Campers bring lunch or buy it through the Threefold Cafe program. Arrival 8:45 to 9; bus dismissal from 3:30, car pickup 3:45 to 4. Campership Fund for families who need help.
